title: bgp --json envelope
description: PLANNED CONTRACT, NOT IMPLEMENTED in package 0.1.0. Planned for every --json command; exactly one such object is printed on stdout. Contract frozen in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-13-bandgap-web.md (Task 1) and docs/frontends.md (to be written).

command.description: Command that produced this envelope, e.g. predict, bands, structure show, runs list, runs show, backends, doctor, assets verify.

ok.description: True only when a successful result (status == success) was produced.

result.description: result.json payload for gap commands; structure report for 'structure show'; run summary/list payload for 'runs'.

bands.description: bands.json payload when the command produced one; null otherwise.

kind.description: input=2, preflight=3, run=4, parse=5, interrupted=130, unsupported=2, internal=1

artifact_path.description: Absolute path of the allocated run directory, present whenever one exists (including failed and interrupted runs).

exit_code.description: Process exit code of the command.
